image_reading: Minimal white text card with centered black Russian disclaimer text.
The frame is static UI-like typography; the wording and layout are the key content.
analysis.article_context: Gallery image in the product section, functioning as a medical safety disclaimer: contraindications are present and specialist consultation is necessary.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation underscores that product use has contraindications and requires consultation with a specialist.
structured_intent.primary_action: A soft optical highlight passes once across the existing disclaimer text.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The existing disclaimer text is fully clear and motionless in the final frame.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The disclaimer remains an unchanged, serious, fully legible medical-safety notice until the last frame.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, keep the card completely fixed while a restrained optical sheen travels gradually across the existing letters, emphasizing readability without changing any glyph, spacing, or contrast structure. It settles before the last moments, ending on the same fully legible disclaimer.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. A very soft light sheen slowly passes across the existing black disclaimer letters from left to right, leaving all wording and layout unchanged; by the final frame the text is fully clear and still.

models.scene_plan: Use the five-second duration for one gentle, continuous optical accent over the pre-existing text. The highlight moves evenly across the lines and naturally fades near the end; no UI state, lettering, or composition changes.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed frame; a subtle soft highlight glides once across the existing disclaimer text and fades, with every word and layout unchanged. End on a crisp, motionless readable warning.

models.scene_plan: In four seconds, animate only a single low-intensity light sheen across the already visible typography. Keep the white card and all Russian text unchanged throughout, with the sheen gone by the final clear, static frame.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. A faint soft sheen passes once over the existing warning text, then fades; the final frame holds the exact, fully legible disclaimer unchanged.
